Sinful 5 Minute French Toast
By: housewifeindubai
Published: Friday, July 23, 2010 - 10:15am

Ingredients




1 egg
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg (optional)
1 teaspoon sugar
2 tablespoons milk
Banana slices
Peanut butter
Strawberry jam
Toast (I prefer milk toast)

Preparation

1 Mix egg, milk, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg 2 Spread peanut butter on one layer of toast, jam on the other and put banana slices then place 2 layers on top of each other 3 Dip both sides of the sandwich in the egg mix 4 Butter a pan, fry both sides until gold-brown
